Subject: Next step: ML/Infra deep-dive — preflight checklist & slot selection

Hi Spenser / Elena —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap: NebulaCorp is primarily focused on improving inference tail-latency for conversational agents and running a cost/throughput evaluation for a high-concurrency workload (50–100 qps steady, spikes to 400 qps). We recommended a 60–90 minute ML/Infra deep-dive that includes a short architecture review, perf targets, and a hands-on ops runthrough.

Attached: post-call notes and a draft mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx). I also dropped a concise preflight checklist (preflight-checklist.md) — the main asks are listed below so we can tailor the session.

Proposed 60–90m agenda (we can adjust):
- 5m introductions and goals
- 15m NebulaCorp workload & constraints (you)
- 25m Redwood serving runtime overview + perf profiles
- 20m Ops deep-dive: batching, KV/prefix cache, quantization options
- 20m Q&A + next steps / mutual action items

To schedule, please pick one of these windows (all PT):
- Tue May 18: 10:00–11:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed May 19: 09:30–11:00 or 16:00–17:30

If those don't work, share a few alternatives and we'll triangulate. Also let me know the attendee list from your side (engineers + procurement? anyone else). Connor will bring the ops/readout; Marissa will own any licensing/SLA questions.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Ben — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. Quick answers up front:
- Our core infra owner (me) and one ML infra engineer (Elena) would attend; procurement lead might join the final 15m depending on timing.
- We're particularly interested in how Redwood handles KV cache persistence across restarts and what the expected cold-start tail looks like for our 8k token context use case.
- Procurement timeline: aiming to finalize vendor shortlist by July, so this deep-dive is critical for evaluation.

On availability: Wed May 19 at 09:30–11:00 PT works best for us. If possible, could you include a short cost-per-token / cost-per-inference ballpark for the scenarios you show? That will help us prioritize tests.

Also: small ask — can you add a short "what success looks like" slide to the agenda for the meeting? Helps our execs.

Thanks,
Spenser
